name: Inlay
description: Inlaid work: a fine chequer of open and closed squares set into a solid ground.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @doodle(@grid: 4 / 100%; background: #000; @odd { background: #0000; }); mask: @doodle(@grid: 4 / 100%; background: #000; @odd { background: #0000; }); -webkit-mask-size: 100% 100%; mask-size: 100% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
